INVALID_ARGUMENT.description: The request payload failed schema validation, missing required field, or had out-of-range parameters.

EXPIRED.description: The request expires_at timestamp has already elapsed upon receipt or queue processing.

UNAUTHORIZED.description: The client identity or token lacks permissions for the requested operation or entity.

UNKNOWN_OPERATION.description: The requested operation is not registered or supported by any active domain handler.

RESOURCE_BUSY.description: The targeted hardware subsystem or lease is held by another higher/equal-priority owner.

RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.description: The specified entity_id, task_id, reminder_id, or approval_id does not exist.

OPERATION_TIMEOUT.description: Execution exceeded allocated deadline without receiving confirmation.

HARDWARE_FAULT.description: Hardware driver or peripheral reported a stall, bus error, or limit violation.

UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.description: Upstream service (HA Core, Tuya Cloud, or Codex app-server) is disconnected or unreachable.

STATE_UNCONFIRMED.description: The command was accepted upstream, but physical state verification failed or timed out.

APPROVAL_REJECTED.description: The explicit human approval for this turn or item was rejected.

TASK_INTERRUPTED.description: The task was explicitly cancelled or interrupted by user command.

DUPLICATE_REQUEST.description: Request with identical request_id was previously received. Returning cached result.
